final: WITH bucket_counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT timespan, order_count, CAST(order_count AS REAL) / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM bucket_counts), kept AS (SELECT order_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS excess FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(excess) AS average_excess FROM kept
